code='''def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the equal-sized regions on either side of a solid divider.

    Keep cells occupied in both regions and recolor them 2.
    """
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full, nonzero row/column marks the split.
    div = next((r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] != 0 and all(x == grid[r][0] for x in grid[r])), None)
    if div is not None and div > 0 and h-div-1 == div:
        a, b = grid[:div], grid[div+1:]
        return [[2 if a[r][c] != 0 and b[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(div)]
    div = next((c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid)), None)
    if div is not None and div > 0 and w-div-1 == div:
        return [[2 if row[c] != 0 and row[div+1+c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(div)] for row in grid]
    raise ValueError("Could not find equal regions separated by a solid line")
'''
p=programs/'task-97151950.py'; p.write_text(code)
